messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] billing-metering-heartbeat: token-emitter lag spike detected across prod shards (emit delay median ~14m, 90p ~35m). Auto-escalation -> incidents channel.
ryan_oncall: seeing it, picking up. can someone confirm customer-visible overage alerts? :eyes:
ali_billing: confirmed: a subset of customers got overage notifications around 12:07 UTC. Alerts appear tied to delayed ingestion -> replay created larger deltas when backfilled.
kate_sre: quick health checks: emitter-latency alarm on kafka-proxy is firing; partition lag up ~120k. No obvious pod crashes.
jose_eng: looking at emitter metrics, looks like a flurry of retries from the token-aggregator from 11:50->12:05. Suspect retry storm + consumer group rebalance.
maya_product: customer reports coming in via support: 3 enterprise accounts flagged for overages. Need an ETA before we notify customers.
ryan_oncall: triage plan: 1) pause auto-overage notifications (billing) 2) throttle emitter retries 3) run targeted backfill with rate caps. Ali, can you pause notifications?
ali_billing: pausing outbound overage emails now (`/billing/notifications/overage: disabled`). Confirmed disabled at 12:18 UTC.
ops-bot: action_log: billing.notifications.overage toggled -> false by ali_billing at 2026-03-17T12:18:07Z
kate_sre: attempting consumer group restart for token-ingest-consumers on shard-08 to clear rebalance. Doing rolling restart to avoid bigger lag.
jose_eng: applying temporary 2x throttling to emitter retry policy (backoff multiplier -> 2.0). patch: ```
# patch
PATCH /emitter/config
{ "retry_backoff_mult": 2.0 }
```
ryan_oncall: good — also enable prefix-KV cache for the busiest model routes to reduce emitter pressure. jose, can you flip the cache flag?
jose_eng: enabling prefix cache for /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings on prod region-us-east-1. Will monitor effect.
ali_billing: running limited recon to find which customers were affected for rollback credits. Starting query: `SELECT customer_id, sum(tokens_delta) FROM billing_delta WHERE emit_time BETWEEN '2026-03-17T11:45:00Z' AND '2026-03-17T12:30:00Z' GROUP BY customer_id;`
kate_sre: consumer group restart reduced partition lag to ~10k after 4 minutes. Metric: kafka_proxy.consumer_lag (shard-08) 120k -> 9.8k.
maya_product: support: holding on external comms until we have a mitigation ETA. If this is >30m we should send a heads-up.
ryan_oncall: rough ETA: stabilize ingestion and halt noisy retries in ~10-15m. Backfill + reconciliation likely 1.5-3h depending on size of replay.
ops-bot: incident-note: mitigations applied: billing.notifications paused, retry throttle applied, consumer group rolling restart, prefix cache enabled.
ali_billing: initial recon: 12 customers show >1.5x token delta vs expected for window. Extracting list for credits.
jose_eng: patching emitter to reject duplicate ack replays (guard flag) to avoid double-counting on backfill. Hotfix pushed to canary at 12:28, promoting to prod if green.
kate_sre: canary for hotfix looks stable for 5m -> promoting. kafka lag trending down.
ryan_oncall: preparing postmortem items: root cause hypothesis = retry storm after transient consumer timeout -> replayed messages + no dedupe on backfill -> double-counts -> overage flags.
maya_product: agree. Need comms template if customers request refunds/credits. Ali, prepare draft.
ali_billing: draft ready, saving to #support-drafts. Will share here.
ops-bot: action_log: emitter.retry_throttle=2.0 by jose_eng at 2026-03-17T12:26:15Z
ryan_oncall: resolution checklist: keep notifications paused until recon complete, run backfill with dedupe guard, validate reconciled token totals vs shadow ledger, apply credits where needed, ship postmortem.
jose_eng: starting dedupe-aware backfill job now with `--rate-limit 5000/s` and idempotency keys enabled.
kate_sre: monitoring token-emit success rate and billing write TPS. initial stability looks good. No new overage flags observed since pause.
maya_product: holding support comms; will send a heads-up at 13:00 UTC if still unresolved.
ali_billing: finished initial customer list & delta amounts. will hold credit application until after full recon.
ryan_oncall: marking incident as "Mitigated - active reconciliation". Will update incident channel when recon completes or if customer impact grows. Thanks team. :clap:
incident-bot: [UPDATE] mitigation actions applied. Please continue to monitor.
ryan_oncall: followups: (1) postmortem owner: kate_sre (2) hotfix review: jose_eng (3) billing playbook update: ali_billing.
kate_sre: acknowledged, will own postmortem and include timeline + metric thresholds for consumer restarts.
jose_eng: will open PR for durable dedupe guard and improved emitter backpressure.
ali_billing: will update billing runbook with a safe-mode to auto-suspend notifications when ingestion lag > 5m.
ops-bot: incident-close-proposal scheduled for 2026-03-17T15:30:00Z if recon passes and no new anomalies.
ryan_oncall: last check-in: consumer lag stable < 2k, backfill running at 4.8k/s, no new overage emails sending. moving to close-watch.
maya_product: noted. closing loop with support on affected customers and offering credits if final reconciliation confirms overcounts.
